Coram : VIKRAM NATH*, PRASANNA BHALACHANDRA VARALE
Issue for Consideration Whether a second suit for arrears of rent and damages would be maintainable or barred under Order II Rule 2 Civil Procedure Code (CPC) if a prior suit was filed seeking a permanent injunction and the handover of vacant possession, especially after the the right in the first suit to pursue claims regarding arrears of rent and damages separately and was granted leave to file a separate suit.
